capabilities: Index all markdown notes locally with a built-in BM25 search engine
Send retrieved note chunks as context to a chosen LLM provider
Chat in a side panel with clickable citations that open the referenced note
Keep the index updated automatically as notes are created, edited, renamed or deleted
Connect to local LLM servers such as Ollama, llama.cpp, LM Studio or Jan without an API key
disambiguation: Despite the RAG name, retrieval uses a built-in BM25 keyword index, not vector embeddings.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Indexing is fully local, but note chunks are sent to the chosen LLM provider when asking questions; local providers avoid this.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to ask natural-language questions of your vault and get answers grounded in your notes with citations.

relations.evidence: choose your server type (Ollama, llama.cpp, LM Studio, Jan, or other OpenAI-compatible)

requires.name: API key for the chosen cloud provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, Groq, xAI, DeepSeek, Cohere, Together AI, Perplexity)
Local LLM server (Ollama, llama.cpp, LM Studio, Jan) for local providers

summary: Vault chat plugin that answers questions from your notes using local BM25 retrieval and any LLM provider, with clickable source citations.
